definitions.explanation: Describes something moving or resting in a soft, light, airy manner, like floating or drifting.
Describes a soft, fluffy texture or appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ふわっと⟦{揺|ゆ}れた→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ふわっと⟦{漂|ただよ}って→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A pleasant scent drifted over softly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風船|ふうせん}→風船：14623_fuusen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ふわっと⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かんだ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: The balloon floated softly up into the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦パンケーキ→パンケーキ：28809_pankeeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ふわっと⟦{焼|や}けた→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧。
ふわっと⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a cake with a fluffy texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦オムレツ→オムレツ：10807_omuretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ふわっと⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧。
examples.english: If you beat the eggs well, the omelet will turn out nice and fluffy.

notes:
ONOMATOPOEIA TYPE:
Mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) describing light, soft movement or texture.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ふわっと⟦{浮|う}く→浮く：00413_uku⟧ (to float lightly)
- ふわっと⟦{香|かお}る→香る：14841_kaoru⟧ (to waft fragrantly)
- ふわっと⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧ (to sway gently)
- ふわっと⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧ (to turn out fluffy)

FORMS:
- ⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧: repeated form emphasizing fluffy texture
- ⟦ふんわり→ふんわり：10477_funwari⟧: similar meaning, slightly more deliberate softness

COOKING USAGE:
Very common for describing desired texture of baked goods, eggs, etc.
